_about: Identities whose recorded discipline appears nowhere among their members' mapped disciplines. Item 9 of Sam's cross-list decision sheet, 2026-09-22: their own worklist, ahead of the cross-list pass.
_read_this_first: `decidable` is the column that matters. A false there means the payload holds nothing to check a proposed discipline against — the members disagree, or every signal rests on a one or two character subject code, or the row carries an approved identifier. Filling those from the modal member would reproduce the `ES`-reads-Ethnic-Studies error in reverse. ⚠ And `members_say` is what the colleges typed, never a verdict on the parent: AUTD M1040 Medium and Heavy Truck Drivetrain Service is recorded Diesel Mechanics while its members read Automotive Technology, and Diesel Mechanics is arguably the better answer. A decidable row is one a curator can settle from what is here, whichever way they settle it.
